lines: 2020 年，OpenAI 做了一个很笨的实验。
In 2020, OpenAI ran a deliberately dumb experiment.
架构没换，还是 Transformer 解码器，目标也没换。
Same architecture, same decoder, same objective.
他们几乎只做一件事：把参数、数据、算力一起加大。
They did one thing: make parameters, data and compute bigger.
参数扩大约一百倍，从十五亿加到一千七百五十亿。
Parameters grew about a hundredfold, from 1.5B to 175B.
结果不只是错误率降低，它会写文章、翻译、写代码。
The result was not just lower error: it wrote, translated and coded.
这一章要问：大为什么有用，又为什么不够。
This chapter asks why size helps, and why it is not enough.
GPT-3 有一千七百五十亿参数，九十六层。
GPT-3 has 175 billion parameters and 96 layers.
隐藏维度一万二千二百八十八，训练数据约三千亿 token。
Hidden size 12,288; training data about 300 billion tokens.
它从来没有专门为翻译或写代码训练过。
It was never trained specifically for translation or code.
但它能写文章、翻译、写代码，还多出一种能力。
Yet it wrote, translated, coded, and showed one new ability.
只要在提示里给几个例子，它就能照着做。
Give it a few examples in the prompt, and it follows along.
窗对应 window，模型一个参数都没更新。
Window comes out; not a single parameter was updated.
这种做法叫上下文学习，例子放进上下文，模型照着做。
This is in-context learning: examples go into the context.
没有梯度下降，没有微调，参数一个都没变。
No gradient descent, no fine-tuning, no weight change.
传统微调把学到的东西写进权重，是永久的。
Fine-tuning writes what it learns into the weights, permanently.
上下文学习把例子放在激活里，会话结束就没了。
In-context learning keeps examples in activations, gone with the session.
所以上下文是临时记忆，权重是长期记忆。
So context is temporary memory; weights are long-term memory.
临时记忆灵活、可撤销，但容量受窗口限制。
Temporary memory is flexible and undoable, but the window bounds it.
2020 年，Kaplan 等人把更大更好写成了公式。
In 2020, Kaplan and colleagues turned bigger-is-better into a formula.
测试集上的交叉熵损失，随参数量呈幂律下降。
Test cross-entropy falls as a power law in parameter count.
随训练 token 数、随训练算力，也都是幂律。
The same holds for training tokens and for training compute.
三个指数分别约零点零七六、零点零九五、零点零五。
The exponents are about 0.076, 0.095 and 0.050.
幂律的意思是，取对数之后，它是一条直线。
A power law means a straight line once you take logs.
指数很小，损失下降得慢，但十倍规模带来可观改善。
Small exponents mean slow decline, yet ten times scale still helps.
这条直线跨越了七个数量级，还能继续外推。
That line spans seven orders of magnitude, and it extrapolates.
幂律直接画在普通坐标上，形状会骗人。
A power law drawn on ordinary axes can mislead.
横轴从十亿到千亿，前段很陡，后段几乎压平。
From a billion to a hundred billion: steep, then almost flat.
把横轴和纵轴都取对数，幂律才露出原形。
Take the log of both axes, and the power law shows its shape.
一条笔直的下降线，斜率就是负的幂指数。
A straight descending line whose slope is the negative exponent.
这条线让外推成为可能：小模型能预测大模型。
That line makes extrapolation possible: small models predict large ones.
所以往规模里投钱，才谈得上是估算，不是赌博。
So spending on scale becomes an estimate, not a gamble.
这条线为什么重要？它把一次豪赌变成了工程估算。
Why does it matter? It turns a gamble into an engineering estimate.
第一步，先用几百万美元，训几个小模型。
Step one: train a few small models for a few million dollars.
第二步，把这些小模型的点，拟合成一条直线。
Step two: fit those points with a straight line.
第三步，外推到目标规模，预测它能到什么水平。
Step three: extrapolate to the target scale and predict its level.
第四步，再决定这一亿美元到底要不要投。
Step four: decide whether the hundred million is worth spending.
在科学方法上，这是一次从定性到定量的跃迁。
Methodologically, this is a leap from qualitative to quantitative.
Kaplan 的结论之一是，给定算力，优先加参数。
One Kaplan conclusion: with fixed compute, add parameters first.
2022 年，DeepMind 的 Chinchilla 论文推翻了它。
In 2022, DeepMind's Chinchilla paper overturned that advice.
Hoffmann 等人重做实验，发现原设定有偏差。
Hoffmann and colleagues redid the experiments and found a bias.
学习率调度没有随训练长度调整，结论因此偏了。
The learning-rate schedule did not scale with run length.
修正后，计算最优是每个参数配二十个 token。
Corrected, compute-optimal means about twenty tokens per parameter.
七百亿参数的 Chinchilla，配一点四万亿 token。
Chinchilla has 70 billion parameters and 1.4 trillion tokens.
在几乎所有基准上，它超过了更大的 Gopher。
On nearly every benchmark it beat the larger Gopher.
也超过了一千七百五十亿参数的 GPT-3。
It also beat GPT-3 at 175 billion parameters.
就用正文里的数字，把这个配比手算一遍。
Let us do that ratio by hand, with numbers from the text.
GPT-3 有一千七百五十亿参数，按二十倍配数据。
GPT-3 has 175 billion parameters; twenty tokens each.
需要三点五万亿个 token，比实际数据多得多。
That asks for 3.5 trillion tokens, far more than it saw.
它实际只训练了约三千亿个 token。
In practice it trained on about 300 billion tokens.
三千亿除以三点五万亿，大约是十二分之一。
300 billion over 3.5 trillion is about one twelfth.
所以当时的大模型，普遍参数过剩、数据不足。
So models then were parameter-rich and data-poor.
规模变大，不只是错误率降低，有些能力像突然出现。
Scaling does more than cut errors: some abilities seem to appear.
2022 年，Wei 等人系统记录了这类现象。
In 2022, Wei and colleagues systematically documented this.
三位数加减法，小模型几乎靠猜，准确率接近零。
On three-digit arithmetic, small models guess: accuracy near zero.
模型大到某个规模，准确率突然跳到很高。
Past some size, accuracy suddenly jumps very high.
他们把这种能力叫涌现能力，小模型没有，大模型才有。
They call these emergent abilities: absent small, present large.
这个说法很符合直觉，也很像物理学里的相变。
It fits intuition, and it looks like a phase transition in physics.
水到零度突然结冰，微观参数连续，宏观性质突变。
Water freezes at zero: continuous micro-parameters, abrupt macro-change.
但 2023 年，Schaeffer 等人提出了一个尖锐的反驳。
But in 2023, Schaeffer and colleagues pushed back sharply.
他们指出，所谓涌现，很可能是指标选择造成的假象。
They argue emergence may be a mirage created by the metric.
用完全答对才算对的不连续指标，曲线就会突然跃起。
An all-or-nothing metric makes the curve leap suddenly.
换成对数概率这种连续指标，同一次提升是平滑的。
Switch to a continuous metric, and the same gain looks smooth.
能力可能一直在连续增长，只是我们的尺子刻度跳跃。
Ability may grow continuously; our ruler has coarse ticks.
他们换了几种指标重测，涌现就消失了。
Re-measure with several metrics, and the emergence vanishes.
稳妥的说法是，能力连续提升，外部表现可能非线性。
The safe claim: ability rises smoothly, behaviour may not.
第一是数据墙，公开的高质量文本是有限的。
First, the data wall: high-quality text is finite.
有估算认为它可能在几年内用尽，这是预测不是定论。
Some estimates say it runs out within years; that is a forecast.
第二是算力与电力，前沿模型成本已达数亿美元量级。
Second, compute and power: frontier training costs hundreds of millions.
第三是推理成本，模型越大，每次调用越贵。
Third, inference cost: bigger models cost more per call.
第四是收益递减，指数很小，再提升要付指数级代价。
Fourth, diminishing returns: small exponents mean steep prices.
于是行业分流，小模型超额训练，或者稀疏激活，还有合成数据。
So the field split: overtrained small models, sparse activation, synthetic data.
最后说两个大家常踩的误解，都跟规模有关。
Two common mistakes, both about scale.
第一，参数量大，绝不等于这个模型能力就强。
First, many parameters never meant strong ability.
Chinchilla 用七百亿，超过了二千八百亿的 Gopher。
Chinchilla at 70 billion beat Gopher at 280 billion.
第二，榜单分数高，也不等于在你的场景里可用。
Second, a high benchmark score is not usability in your setting.
榜单是固定题集，分数高不代表延迟低、成本低。
Benchmarks are fixed sets; high scores say nothing about latency or cost.
这一章的一句话：损失随规模按幂律下降。
In one sentence: loss falls as a power law with scale.
但配比怎么定、天花板在哪，和参数一样重要。
But the ratio and the ceilings matter as much as parameters.
模型现在很会接着往下写，却还不太听话。
The model is good at continuing text, but not at obeying.
你让它写一首诗，它可能给你写一篇论文。
Ask for a poem and you may get a paper instead.
下一章讲对齐，怎么把文本预测器变成助手。
Next chapter: alignment, turning a predictor into an assistant.
